title: Entra Conditional Access policy input (report-only demo artifact)
description: Declarative shape for a Microsoft Graph conditionalAccessPolicies resource, restricted to report-only demo usage. This file is validated statically and is never sent to Microsoft Graph by this repository. Field shapes follow the Microsoft Graph conditionalAccessPolicy resource: conditions.users.includeUsers accepts 'All', 'None', 'GuestsOrExternalUsers', or user object IDs; conditions.users.includeRoles must contain Microsoft Entra built-in directory role *template IDs* (GUIDs), never display names or the non-Graph value 'All users'.

state.description: Must remain report-only for this demo. enabledForReportingButNotEnforced never blocks or requires a control.

includeUsers.description: Graph-compatible subject scope. Use exactly ['All'] for an all-users policy; individual entries otherwise are Entra user object IDs, 'None', or 'GuestsOrExternalUsers'.

includeRoles.description: Microsoft Entra built-in directory role *template IDs* (GUIDs) from identity/schema/known-entra-ids.json, never display names or the non-Graph value 'All users'.

excludeGroups.description: Must contain at least one emergency-access (break-glass) group placeholder. Never leave empty.

includeAuthenticationContextClassReferen.description: Microsoft Graph authenticationContextClassReference id(s) ('c1'..'c25') that scope this policy to a specific claim raised by a resource, e.g. by PIM role activation. Fixed, tenant-independent Graph claim values documented in identity/schema/known-entra-ids.json; must stay coherent with any identity/pim/*.template.json activation.authenticationContext that references the same id.

applications.description: Mutually exclusive Graph target shape: a policy either scopes to application(s) via includeApplications, or scopes to a specific authentication context via includeAuthenticationContextClassReferences, never both at once.

builtInControls.description: 'authenticationStrength' is intentionally not a valid value here: Microsoft Graph models authentication strength as the separate grantControls.authenticationStrength relationship, not as a builtInControls entry.

id.description: Built-in Microsoft Graph authenticationStrengthPolicy id: 000...002 = Multifactor authentication, 000...003 = Passwordless MFA, 000...004 = Phishing-resistant MFA. See identity/schema/known-entra-ids.json.

authenticationStrength.description: Models the Microsoft Graph grantControls.authenticationStrength relationship: a reference to an authenticationStrengthPolicy id, not a builtInControls string.

placeholder.description: Object ID of the emergency-access/break-glass group or user. In the committed template this must remain a REPLACE_WITH_* placeholder; a locally populated (never committed) copy replaces it with a real group/user object ID before any apply workflow runs. See scripts/validate-identity-artifacts.sh --mode.
